front_matter.title: vessel
front_matter.description: A craft that comes in, moors at a berth and leaves.

markdown:
A craft that comes in, moors at a berth and leaves. ## Depends on - [berth](../1-shore/berth.mdx) · layer 1 · shore · 4 references ## Used by - [tug](./tug.mdx) · layer 2 · craft · 4 references ## Entities ### Vessel Identified by `vessel_id` (`VesselId`). | field | type | |---|---| | `berth_id` | `BerthId` | | `started_at` | `timestamp` | Relations: - `berth_id` references **Berth** of [berth](../1-shore/berth.mdx) (one, by `berth_id`) ## Commands ### RetireVessel **Retire a vessel.** | field | type | |---|---| | `vessel_id` | `VesselId` | | `at` | `timestamp` | | outcome | when | result | |---|---|---| | `no-such-vessel` (refused) | no such Vessel | `VesselNotFound`: No vessel of this identity exists. | | `retired` | otherwise | moves the **Vessel** `Active` → `Retired`; emits `VesselRetired` | | `wrong-state` (refused) | the Vessel is in a state that does not allow it | `VesselStateConflict`: The vessel is not in a state this command acts from. | ### StartVessel **Start a vessel.** | field | type | |---|---| | `vessel_id` | `VesselId` | | `berth_id` | `BerthId` | | `at` | `timestamp` | | outcome | when | result | |---|---|---| | `started` | otherwise | creates a **Vessel** in `Active`; emits `VesselStarted` | ## Events | event | fields | emitted by | |---|---|---| | `VesselRetired` | `vessel_id` VesselId, `at` timestamp | `RetireVessel` | | `VesselStarted` | `vessel_id` VesselId, `at` timestamp | `StartVessel` | ## Views | view | rows | fields | |---|---|---| | `Vessels`
Vessels | each **Vessel** | `vessel_id` VesselId, `berth_id` BerthId, `started_at` timestamp, `state` State | ## KPIs 1 KPI from the [KPI catalogue](../../kpis.mdx). ### Soundness | KPI | unit | better | gate | status | |---|---|---|---|---| | `vessel_unmoored_count`
Vessels in the harbor that are moored at no berth.
By tides: flood: lower, ebb: lower | count | lower | gate | sketched | ## Documents using it - [cove](../../plan/cove.mdx) (Harbor plans) · 1 part - [inlet](../../plan/inlet.mdx) (Harbor plans) · 1 part - [reef](../../plan/reef.mdx) (Harbor plans) · 1 part
